basic_details.job_title: IIITDM Kancheepuram Project Technical Support III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Information Technology, Design and Manufacturing (IIITDM), Kancheepuram has invited online applications for the post of Project Technical Support - III under the ICMR-sponsored project titled "Development of a transvaginal probe-based dermatoscope with automated AI-enabled decision support for detection of cancers and infections". The last date to submit online applications is 10th November 2026. Candidates are required to submit their applications online through the official link and must be present physically at IIITDM Kancheepuram located at Chennai - 600127 for the writ

qualification.details: First-class postgraduate degree, including integrated PG degrees; or Second Class Post Graduate Degree, including integrated PG degrees with PhD; or For Engineering – First Class Graduate Degree of Four Years.

how_to_apply: Interested candidates are requested to submit their applications online through the official form link.
While uploading, attach documents according to the format given in the Annexure.
Take a printout of the application form, fill it, sign it, and submit the hard copy at the time of the interview.
Produce all educational and experience certificates at the time of the interview for verification.
For any clarification regarding the application process, contact the Principal Investigator via email at [email protected].
important_instructions: The post is purely on a contractual basis. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Candidates must produce all original educational and experience certificates during verification at the interview. Candidates currently working in Central, State, Semi-Govt, PSU, or Autonomous Bodies of the Government must submit an NOC issued by their present employer if applicable.

content_sections.heading: About IIITDM Kancheepuram Project Technical Support - III
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Information Technology, Design and Manufacturing, Kancheepuram is an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, located at Melakottaiyur, Off Vandalur - Kelambakkam Road, Chennai-600127. The recruitment is conducted for a Research and Development position under the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering for a project funded by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) led by Principal Investigator Dr. Uttam Mrinal Pal.

content_sections.heading: IIITDM Kancheepuram Project Technical Support - III at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify an application fee.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Information Technology, Design and Manufacturing, Kancheepuram
Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering
Development of a transvaginal probe-based dermatoscope with automated AI-enabled decision support for detection of cancers and infections
Purely on a contractual basis and till 01st June 2027
₹ 28,000 + 30% HRA (Note: 30% HRA will be paid if no accommodation is provided by the Institute)
35 years as on the last date of receiving the application (Age relaxation is applicable as per GoI norms)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential educational qualifications and age limits prescribed for the position. First-class postgraduate degree, including integrated PG degrees; or Second Class Post Graduate Degree, including integrated PG degrees with PhD; or For Engineering – First Class Graduate Degree of Four Years. Proficiency in 3D modeling and mechanical design using SolidWorks and/or Autodesk Fusion 360 to prototype ergonomic, clinically safe medical imaging probes, along with familiarity with rapid prototyping workflows (e.g., 3D printing and slicing software). Experience using Simulation Tools such as COMSOL Multiphysics or ANSYS for structural, thermal, or optomechanical simulations to validate the design, safety, and reliability of the probe. Ability to design precision mounts and enclosures for optical components (lenses, sensors, lighting), factoring in spatial constraints for field of view and working distances. Well versant in Python libraries: OpenCV, MediaPipe, Tkinter and integration of real-time AI model with industrial machine vision cameras will be an additional advantage. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a stipend of ₹ 28,000 plus 30% House Rent Allowance (HRA). The 30% HRA will be paid if no accommodation is provided by the Institute. The position is purely on a contractual basis and will continue until 01st June 2027.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIITDM Kancheepuram Project Technical Support - III
content_sections.text: Interested candidates are requested to submit their applications online through the official form link. While uploading, attach documents according to the format given in the Annexure. Take a printout of the application form, fill it, sign it, and submit the hard copy at the time of the interview. Produce all educational and experience certificates at the time of the interview for verification. For any clarification regarding the application process, contact the Principal Investigator via email at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of a written test followed by an interview. The topic for the written test along with the syllabus will be shared later. Candidates should be present physically at IIITDM Kancheepuram located at Chennai - 600127 for the written test and/or interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The post is purely on a contractual basis. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Candidates must produce all original educational and experience certificates during verification at the interview. Candidates currently working in Central, State, Semi-Govt, PSU, or Autonomous Bodies of the Government must submit an NOC issued by their present employer if applicable.
